column1: Preheat the oven to 300°F (150°C) and grease a 10-inch round cake pan.
Heat the sugar, water and salt in a small saucepan over medium heat, stirring until dissolved; set aside.
Melt the chocolate in the microwave in 15-second bursts, stirring between each, then transfer to a stand mixer bowl.
Cut the butter into pieces and beat it into the warm chocolate one piece at a time.
Beat in the hot sugar syrup, then add the eggs one at a time, mixing well after each.
Pour the batter into the prepared pan and set it inside a larger pan; add boiling water to come halfway up the cake pan.
Bake in the water bath for 45 minutes; the center will still look wet.
Refrigerate until fully chilled, at least 8 hours or overnight.
Dip the bottom of the pan in hot water for about 10 seconds and invert onto a serving plate.
